g.aria-label: The Parameter Update Swamping Trap on the bfloat16 Number Line
bfloat16 representable grid near w = 1.0 (spacing eps = 2⁻⁷ = 0.0078125)
Any update |Δw| < ½ eps · |w| (i.e. |η·g| < 0.0039 at w = 1.0) rounds back to 1.0000000!
In Fashion-MNIST MLP (η = 0.01), ~90% of pure-bf16 updates vanish—fp32 master weights fix this completely.
